page_content.title: Roost Enterprise Login | Software as a Service
main_features: Provides a login interface for Roost Enterprise users.
Sign-in options include integrations with Google, Github, Microsoft, Okta, Auth0, and PingID.
Includes links to resources such as About Roost, Privacy Policy, Documentation, and API Reference.
Provides options to download CLI and install VS Code extension.
page_content.technical_requirement: JavaScript must be enabled to use the app.

query_analysis.purpose: The page's purpose appears to be providing a login interface for Roost Enterprise users and offering access to related resources and tools.
use_cases: Authentication and login for Roost Enterprise users.
Accessing documentation, API references, and other resources.
Downloading CLI tools and integrating with VS Code for development.
interactive_elements: Login interface with third-party sign-in integrations (e.g., Google, Github, Microsoft, etc.).
Options to download CLI and install VS Code extension.

Integration of generative AI models with testing workflows.
Code repository integration for seamless testing of source code.
Advanced testing options like vulnerability testing and custom configurations.

Integration with various git platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure.
Creating, managing, and executing test plans for applications.
Triggering tests, retriggering tests, and aborting test executions.
Event management and log retrieval for tests.
Sending event diagnostics to Slack for debugging purposes.
